SA.physical_anchor: Undeveloped gold-copper-silver deposit (KSM project) in British Columbia, plus the Iskut exploration project
SA.value_chain_position: Pre-production developer advancing the large-tonnage KSM gold-copper deposit through permitting/financing toward construction; no current mine revenue

SCZM.physical_anchor: Mined silver-lead-zinc ore processed into concentrate at operations in Mexico and Bolivia
SCZM.value_chain_position: Mid-tier polymetallic producer selling silver-lead-zinc concentrates to smelters; branded a silver miner but zinc/lead dominate realized revenue

SGML.physical_anchor: Battery-grade lithium spodumene concentrate mined and processed at Grota do Cirilo, Brazil
SGML.value_chain_position: Hard-rock lithium producer selling spodumene concentrate to battery/cathode makers; lithium has no chain in this taxonomy (the electrification chain lives in the fdt book)

SIND.physical_anchor: Silver-gold-copper-lead-zinc epithermal deposit under exploration at the Sinda Property, Guanajuato, Mexico
SIND.value_chain_position: Pre-revenue silver exploration company (recent NYSE IPO) advancing the Sinda Property toward a targeted ~2031 first production

SKE.physical_anchor: Eskay Creek high-grade gold-silver deposit under construction/redevelopment in British Columbia
SKE.value_chain_position: Construction-stage developer redeveloping the past-producing Eskay Creek gold-silver mine, targeting near-term first production

SLI.physical_anchor: Lithium brine resource in the Smackover Formation, Arkansas, under development for direct lithium extraction
SLI.value_chain_position: Pre-revenue lithium brine developer building DLE capacity in Arkansas; lithium has no chain in this taxonomy

SXC.physical_anchor: Metallurgical coke produced from purchased coal at cokemaking facilities and sold to blast-furnace steelmakers
SXC.value_chain_position: Toll cokemaker/logistics operator converting purchased coal into coke for steel producers; does not mine or sell ore/concentrate itself

TFPM.physical_anchor: Portfolio of gold and silver streams/royalties entitling delivery of physical metal from producing and development mines
TFPM.value_chain_position: Streaming and royalty company monetizing upfront capital for a fixed share of future gold/silver production, carrying no operating or capex exposure

TGB.physical_anchor: Copper concentrate and cathode produced from an operating open-pit copper mine (BC) and a low-cost ISR copper project (Arizona)
TGB.value_chain_position: Mid-tier copper producer running an operating open-pit mine while ramping a low-cost in-situ-recovery copper project

THM.physical_anchor: Livengood gold deposit under development in Alaska
THM.value_chain_position: Pre-revenue developer advancing feasibility on the large-tonnage, low-grade Livengood gold project

TMC.physical_anchor: Polymetallic nodules (nickel-copper-cobalt-manganese) targeted for harvest from the deep seafloor in the Clarion-Clipperton Zone
TMC.value_chain_position: Pre-revenue deep-sea nodule collection company pursuing permits for battery-metal (Ni/Cu/Co/Mn) harvesting; not a gold/silver name despite the FMP 'Other Precious Metals' tag

TMQ.physical_anchor: Copper-zinc-cobalt-gold-silver deposits (Arctic and Bornite) under development in the Ambler Mining District, Alaska
TMQ.value_chain_position: Pre-revenue developer advancing a polymetallic, copper-dominant deposit pending the Ambler Road access permit

UAMY.physical_anchor: Mined and smelted antimony (antimony metal/trisulfide) plus zeolite products from Montana smelting and Mexico mining operations
UAMY.value_chain_position: One of the only Western antimony miner-smelters, selling antimony products into the strategic-metals stockpile/defense chain

UEC.physical_anchor: In-situ recovery (ISR) mined uranium (U3O8) from Texas and Wyoming wellfields
UEC.value_chain_position: Near-term/restart ISR uranium producer ramping Texas and Wyoming operations toward term-contract delivery

URG.physical_anchor: In-situ recovery (ISR) mined uranium (U3O8) from the Lost Creek project, Wyoming
URG.value_chain_position: Operating ISR uranium producer at Lost Creek, Wyoming, selling U3O8 under term and spot contracts

UROY.physical_anchor: Royalty and streaming interests plus physical uranium holdings entitling delivery of U3O8 from uranium mines/projects
UROY.value_chain_position: Uranium royalty/streaming pure-play holding physical U3O8 and royalty interests across producing and development projects; auto-passes cash/profit gates

USAR.physical_anchor: Rare earth oxides mined/processed at Round Top (Texas) and NdFeB permanent magnets manufactured at the Stillwater plant (Oklahoma)
USAR.value_chain_position: Vertically-integrating rare-earth developer building US magnet manufacturing ahead of its own mine reaching production

USAS.physical_anchor: Silver-lead ore mined and processed into concentrate at the Galena Complex (Idaho) and Cosalá Operations (Mexico)
USAS.value_chain_position: Silver-primary mid-tier producer with lead/zinc/gold byproduct credits from operating US and Mexico mines

USAU.physical_anchor: CK Gold-Copper deposit under development in Wyoming
USAU.value_chain_position: Pre-revenue developer advancing the CK Gold-Copper project toward construction financing

UUUU.physical_anchor: Uranium concentrate (U3O8) milled at White Mesa, Utah, plus rare-earth oxide (NdPr) separation from monazite feed
UUUU.value_chain_position: Only operating conventional uranium mill in the US, co-producing rare-earth oxides and vanadium as alternate-feed byproducts
